851-1283-1651-2557-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Parallel Lives.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
851-1283-1651-2557-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

5571-6922-8249--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6922-8249--6.description:
Use Coveted Falcon to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-7316--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2728-5231-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5231-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5231-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

5733-7722-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-7722-7843.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Notorious Throng, creating a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens and causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Elrond.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Notorious Throng from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng from exile by paying its prowl cost.
Repeat from step 3.

206-924-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
206-924-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
206-924-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
206-924-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

67-4053-5686-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
1251-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7153.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3459-5078-5268-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4094-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-5259-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-6436--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Eccentric Farmer.
When Eccentric Farmer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-6436--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

3693-4613-6843-7061.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Solid Ground.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-2557-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-2557-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2079-3292-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-2079-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

3062-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Pir.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

261-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1170-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lumra.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

292-1495-6627.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-6627.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

2963-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

2793-3921-5089-5668-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

3995-5963-6478.description:
Activate Marvin using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-1817-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1817-5233.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Boros Garrison.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

2457-4434-4762-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
"Treefolk" chosen with Conspiracy.
2457-4434-4762-4875.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Conspiracy, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1350-2713-4617-4720.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1623-2125-2522.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1623-2125-2522.description:
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Temporal Extortion and Witherbloom Apprentice trigger.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, causing you to pay half your life total, rounded up, and then exile Temporal Extortion and cast it without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2 until your life total is equal to one.
Temporal Extortion and Witherbloom Apprentice trigger.
Resolve the Witherbloom Apprentice trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, causing you to pay half your life total, rounded up, and then exile Temporal Extortion and cast it without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 5.

3044-3105-4036-5026.description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ill-Gotten Gains for {2}{B}{B} and hold priority.
Cast Reverberate for {R}{R}, copying Ill-Gotten Gains.
Resolve the copied Ill-Gotten Gains, discarding your hand and then returning Pyretic Ritual, Seething Song, and Reverberate to your hand.
Cast Pyretic Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

148-1218-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Keen Sense attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
148-1218-1525-4298.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Borborygmos +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.
